why: Which days Lakeview counts as call holidays is Lakeview's own rule; only its chiefs can say.

card.title: Lakeview call holidays
card.context: Lakeview OBGYN's chief residents set which days count as holidays for call. Their handbook lists the big holidays but not the day after Thanksgiving.
card.question: Does Lakeview count the day after Thanksgiving as a call holiday?
card.why: It matches what we know so far.
